94:t_006:19.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes, Big Sis! I'll put my heart into helping you!」

94:t_006:20.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I should've been paired with $$ニコラ$$, but this girl keeps clinging to me...」

94:t_006:21.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Did you say something, Big Sis?」

94:t_006:22.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Nothing! Let's hurry and clear out these pests!」

94:t_006:23.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Captain, they seem intent on fighting the unknowns independently.」

94:t_006:24.en:
$$テッサ$$
「They're not enemies, so we can ignore them. I'm more concerned about why they've come here.」

94:t_006:25.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Understood. I'll tell all units to stay alert.」

94:t_006:26.en:
$$アルト$$
「Then we'll act like they aren't here! We'll do this ourselves!」

94:t_006:27.en:
$$勝平$$
「We'll show them our power instead!」

94:t_006:28.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Yeah! We'll wipe them all out ourselves!」

94:t_006:29.en:
$$ニコラ$$
($c... Let's see what you can do.)

94:t_007:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「How condescending can this guy get?」

94:t_007:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「If I offended you, I apologize. We came here to help you.」

94:t_008:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I never thought we'd end up with zero kills... Impressive, $c.」

94:t_008:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「How condescending can this guy get?」

94:t_008:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「If I offended you, I apologize. We came here to help you.」

94:t_009:1.en:
$$メール$$
「Monsters! There are monsters in space!」

94:t_010:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「They're commonly called $$木星急行$$. Normally, this type repeatedly circuits the space around Jupiter.」

94:t_010:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Since transferring to this world, they've been active throughout the solar system.」

94:t_010:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We took out a fair number the other day, but it looks like some survived.」

94:t_010:3.en:
$$チコ$$
「And there are $$ビーストロン級$$s, too...!」

94:t_010:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Did you... come here to fight those $$宇宙怪獣$$?」

94:t_010:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We'll handle them. You should fall back.」

94:t_010:8.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I appreciate the thought, but protecting humanity from $$宇宙怪獣$$ is our job.」

94:t_010:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's right. Don't hesitate to accept our help.」

94:t_010:11.en:
$$甲児$$
「There are a lot of them...! We'll fight with everyone's strength!」

94:t_010:14.en:
$$ノノ$$
「So cool!! That's exactly what a hero should be!」

94:t_010:16.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...All right. If that's what you want, we'll fall back.」

94:t_010:18.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「If they beat those $$宇宙怪獣$$, we'll just proceed as originally planned. Let's go, Princess.」

94:t_011:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Forget them! Our enemies are the $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

94:t_011:2.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Big Sis! Let's fight alongside everyone in $c!」

94:t_011:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ディスヌフ$$ says it wants to fight with everyone, too!」

94:t_011:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ディスヌフ$$ is my $$バスターマシン$$! Don't make things up!」

94:t_011:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「What should we do, $$ニコラ$$?」

94:t_011:7.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Big Sis! Forget what $$ニコラ$$ thinks! Please fight because you want to!」

94:t_011:8.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Because you're a hero, Big Sis!」

94:t_011:10.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノリリ$$ always fought for everyone! Heroes always fight for everyone!」

94:t_012:1.en:
$$チコ$$
「What now, $$ニコラ$$? Are you going to let the Princess fight alone?」

94:t_012:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...We have no choice. We're going in, too.」

94:t_013:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I'm not sure, but it looks like they'll fight alongside us.」

94:t_013:2.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! Everyone in $c, we're counting on you!」

94:t_013:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Save it for later, $$ノノ$$! First, we take out the $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

94:t_013:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes, Big Sis! $$ノノ$$ will give it her all, too!」

94:t_014:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...You're serious about this, $$ニコラ$$?」

94:t_014:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(Because that's what the women on $$タイタン$$ want.)

94:t_014:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$トップレス$$ pilots... I'd like to hear about the $$宇宙怪獣$$. Could you land aboard our ship?」

94:t_014:6.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Gladly. As I said, we've come here to cooperate with you.」

94:t_015:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Do you understand our abilities now?」

94:t_015:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「What!? We won't lose to you, either!」

94:t_015:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(Do your best. Otherwise, there would be no point in my coming here.)

94:t_017:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's my Big Sis! With effort and guts...」
